scenario.title: Research study: students and part-time work
scenario.intro: A researcher from the career center is interviewing students about how they choose and balance part-time jobs.

questions.text: First, could you tell me whether you have a part-time job at the moment, and how many hours a week you usually work or would like to work?
Can you describe a time when a job, or another regular responsibility, made it difficult to keep up with your studies? How did you deal with it?
Some people think students learn more from a part-time job than from many of their classes. Do you agree or disagree, and why?
How do you think the kinds of part-time jobs available to students will change over the next ten years?
